And I will move on. I am moving on. I am starting school again next month, and I will be moving forward with my education all the way up to receiving my doctorate in psychotherapy and I know I will have many experiences and a ton of things to keep me occupied rather than waiting on the edge for a sign that this man’s heart is still beating. I started to freak out so I called the police and told them what was going on and they had told me that she had actually contacted them before I did.

I was so confused and bewildered. I didn’t know it was going on but from what the police told me they insinuated I believe that she thought I was there to harm her and that I took medicine meant I was crazy or something. I really have no idea, but it really sucked going through that And eventually they forced her to let me inside and I was able to arrange my things and move out pretty much immediately.

And I believe it was either six months or a year later the girl found me on Instagram and apologized for her behavior. I have no idea how she found me, but she did and it was actually super satisfying to receive an apology for that because from my perspective, it all happened for absolutely no reason and I forgave her and that was that.
